Title: Public Preview: Azure Container Storage on managed Prometheus

Body.Content:
Azure Container Storage is a cloud-based volume management, deployment and orchestration service and works with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) to effectively scale across storage services while providing a cost-effective, container-native experience. 

 

Customers using Azure Container Storage (ACStor) on AKS clusters can now collect storage pool and disk metrics with Azure Managed Prometheus and view/query metrics in Azure Managed Grafana. 

 

When customers enable ACStor on an AKS cluster where Managed Prometheus is enabled, metrics will be automatically collected and ingested along with other metrics. 

 

Learn more.
